summary: This bounded duplicate-work and contribution-policy check found no equivalent Squeeze retained-byte fix in current upstream code or the project's all-state issue/PR history. The exact candidate fits the documented bug-fix scope and preserves MIT attribution. No explicit AI contribution policy was found; that is not explicit acceptance of AI contributions. No reviewed policy blocks the authorized public-fork publication.
evidence: Current source was checked during the recorded UTC window. `gh api repos/huandu/xstrings` identifies master as the default branch; `gh api repos/huandu/xstrings/commits/master` returned 96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5, equal to the supplied baseline. Sources: https://api.github.com/repos/huandu/xstrings and https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/commit/96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5. At this revision Squeeze still uses WriteRune in both retained-output branches; the candidate changes those two writes to WriteString(str[:size]).

Enumerated every returned issue and PR with `gh api --paginate 'repos/huandu/xstrings/issues?state=all&per_page=100'`: 72 records, including 20 PRs. Independently enumerated all 20 PRs with `gh api --paginate 'repos/huandu/xstrings/pulls?state=all&per_page=100'` and fetched every PR's changed-file list and available patches via `repos/huandu/xstrings/pulls/NUMBER/files?per_page=100`. Titles, bodies, relevant patches, and relevant discussions were checked for Squeeze, invalid UTF-8, RuneError, retained bytes and adjacent Unicode fixes. This covers closed and merged PRs as well as the one open PR. Sources: https://api.github.com/repos/huandu/xstrings/issues?state=all&per_page=100 and https://api.github.com/repos/huandu/xstrings/pulls?state=all&per_page=100.

The only open PR is #72, head 5225f0785bbe8be433ea86662f5389fc6ed6af54. Its files are convert.go and convert_test.go and its change concerns first-rune case mapping, not Squeeze. Source: https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/72.

The directly related Squeeze issues are #11, its original introduction, and #36, a pattern/skip-state defect. Read both issue bodies and comments. The fix for #36, commit 2bf18b218c51864a87384c06996e40ff9dcff8e1, adds skipSqueeze=false when the rune changes; it does not preserve retained invalid bytes. Sources: https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/issues/11, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/issues/36 and https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/commit/2bf18b218c51864a87384c06996e40ff9dcff8e1.

Closed issue #65 is closely related precedent, not an equivalent Squeeze fix. Its discussion and actual fix 610c09ead30efcd51e650d5510b2d7b171b758c1 preserve unmatched bytes in Translator.Translate/Delete and distinguish deletion from RuneError. The patch does not modify Squeeze. The byte-copying technique therefore already exists upstream in another API; the candidate's bounded contribution is applying byte preservation to retained Squeeze input. Sources: https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/issues/65, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/issues/65#issuecomment-5659165578 and https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/commit/610c09ead30efcd51e650d5510b2d7b171b758c1.

Read the relevant translate.go PR patches. PR #70 at b60089cda0dda93d2d395ec5b375b99e2d905cd6 fixes U+FFFD pattern parsing; #71 at f1befd28fdfe66913ee5c9d6fb9e21f40ceb2729 fixes range endpoints. Older #46 changes the buffer type, #47 removes unused assignments, and #55 changes comment formatting in translate.go. None contains the candidate's Squeeze behavior. Closed #58/#60 concern trailing invalid-byte replacement in Scrub; #68 documents Scrub. Sources: https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/70, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/71, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/46, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/47, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/55, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/58, https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/60 and https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/pull/68.

Read current CONTRIBUTING.md, README.md, LICENSE, go.mod and .github/workflows/go.yml at the verified upstream revision. CONTRIBUTING.md welcomes bug reports and PRs, requires formatting and all tests before upstream submission, and requires issue discussion plus README/function-list updates for new APIs or features. The candidate modifies an existing API without adding a function, so the new-function discussion prerequisite does not apply. Sources: https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/blob/96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5/CONTRIBUTING.md and https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/blob/96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5/README.md.

The complete upstream recursive tree returned truncated=false and has no AGENTS.md, PR/issue template, separate security guidance, or additional contributor-policy file. GitHub's community profile lists CONTRIBUTING.md but no issue template, PR template or code of conduct. `gh api repos/huandu/.github` returned HTTP 404, so no public inherited owner-default repository was available. The security policy page reports no configured SECURITY.md. Sources: https://api.github.com/repos/huandu/xstrings/git/trees/96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5?recursive=1, https://api.github.com/repos/huandu/xstrings/community/profile, https://api.github.com/repos/huandu/.github and https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/security/policy.

No explicit AI-generated, AI-assisted or automated-contribution policy, mandatory AI disclosure, human-review condition, CLA, DCO/sign-off, commit-message format, or changelog requirement was found in the examined current contribution sources. CONTRIBUTING.md and README.md link to project issues/API references but no additional contribution-policy document. This records the search result, not an assertion of explicit AI acceptance.

The exact candidate diff was read with `git diff 96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5 ac5ce55dcb3810dc8a5d2a1cd22219e0ef972756 -- translate.go translate_test.go`; only those two files change. It retains existing copyright/license notices, adds 11 cases to the existing Squeeze test table and one API-documentation sentence, adds no dependency, and changes no signature or matching logic. `git diff --check 96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5 ac5ce55dcb3810dc8a5d2a1cd22219e0ef972756` passed. Existing stringBuilder implementations provide WriteString; no new language feature or newer standard-library API is introduced.

go.mod declares Go 1.12; the upstream workflow uses Go 1.17 and runs `go test -v -coverprofile=covprofile.cov ./...`, then uploads coverage through a token-backed service. The saved claim includes formatting, the full suite, Go 1.17 when available, race/coverage and vet. This policy/duplicate reviewer did not execute code or inspect the author's test logs, so it does not independently certify those executions or remote CI. Sources: https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/blob/96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5/go.mod and https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/blob/96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5/.github/workflows/go.yml.

The MIT license permits modification and publication subject to retaining its copyright and permission notices; the candidate leaves them intact. No examined project policy imposes an additional public-fork prerequisite. Source: https://github.com/huandu/xstrings/blob/96b69c7949060424ce4778947e3e32112cb7e3d5/LICENSE.

Future upstream submission is separate: it needs the operator's explicit authorization under the controller policy, a current policy refresh, and satisfaction of the project's formatting/all-tests requirement before submission. No project-specific human agreement or attestation was found, and none was accepted. This review authorizes no upstream contact or PR and claims no publication.

Limit: this is a bounded duplicate-work check of the public project's current default branch, all returned issue/PR records, and relevant history during the recorded UTC window. It does not establish global novelty, inspect private/unsubmitted work, prove correctness or performance, or replace the separate reproduction and criterion reviews.
